name: D-Lab
access_note: If you're interested in data science and social science research, D-Lab is the place to be! Inclusive Excellence Hub
access_note: This hub is for UC Berkeley graduate students looking for a welcoming space to study, connect with peers, and build a sense of belonging. The Hub offers drop-in study and meeting spaces. It is open Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM.
